_source:
A real 'Commerce Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, across three separate Term 1, Term 2 and Term 3 documents. This is a genuine gap fill — this app previously had no Commerce Form 2 content at all (only Form 1). Cites the real official '2024 Commerce Syllabus Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations throughout (Term 1: pg. 15-18; Term 2: pg. 18-22; Term 3: pg. 22-25).

All three terms have genuine, distinct source coverage — no gaps. Each term document's own 'MID-TERM TESTS', 'END OF TERM TESTS', 'FINAL EXAMINATION' and 'REVISION' weeks are excluded, since they name no new specific competences of their own — only real topic/sub-topic weeks are included here.

A real structural feature of the source scheme, preserved rather than 'corrected': Topic 4.2 'Transport' genuinely spans two terms — its first two sub-topics (4.2.1 Importance of Transport, 4.2.2 Modes of Transport) fall in the last two weeks of Term 2, while its remaining three sub-topics (4.2.3 Documents used in Transportation, 4.2.4 Containerisation, 4.2.5 Trends in Transport) open Term 3. This file represents Topic 4.2 twice, once per term, with only the sub-topics that term's own document actually covers under it, matching the real scheme rather than merging or reassigning them.

Content/Concept column text is summarised into each sub-topic's own description; the scheme's own Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 3.1.1 Types of Business Units
